description: This is a PHPUnit test class for the RegistrationEventQueueDao, which tests methods related to registration event queue operations such as fetching registration events by type, retrieving unpublished registration events in batches, and saving registration events. It sets up test data fixtures and verifies DAO behaviors.

classes.name: RegistrationEventQueueDaoTest
